sections.heading: Professional Summary
sections.text: Operations manager with 5 years running a three-city marketplace. Owned a $2M monthly budget and led a loyalty launch that grew active drivers 10% a month.

bullets: Owned a **$2M monthly budget** for driver incentives across 3 cities.
Led the launch of a loyalty program with Legal and Product, reaching **10% monthly growth** in active drivers.
Rebuilt the incentive thresholds with a regression model, cutting cost per active driver by **12%**.
Automated the weekly ops report in Python, saving **6 hours a week** for a team of 8.
Renegotiated a vehicle lease agreement, raising fleet size from **50 to 200**.
